notes.title: Milfvania Ep. 3 early release!
notes.notes:
Hello, here is an early release of Milfvania Ep. 3. This is the final installment of the game. It features:

better story (in my opinion) events are more detailed and spaced out. More character development and more story

experimental pseudo 3D environment

in the next 24 hours I'll release more content and bugfixes (yes, again I was caught off guard by the release date ːsteamhappyː)

I plan to release updates monthly or bi-monthly.
